content:
The audit brief generation failed because the required risk rating and severity mapping were missing from the HWPX XML sections.
The verifier failed in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present with an AssertionError. Specifically, the string 'High (즉시조치)' was not found in the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, the failure indicates that the severity_map logic ('High' to '즉시조치') or the risk rating value was not correctly injected into the HWPX document structure.
